1.label: ТЕКСТ
1.title: Maester Luwin's Morning Notes
1.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
1.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
1.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
1.text:
Winter is not here yet, but everyone in Winterfell seems to feel it coming. This morning, as usual, the younger children are practising archery in the yard while Lord Eddard watches from the gallery. Bran keeps missing the target, and his sister Arya, who is supposed to be sewing, is secretly shooting better than any of the boys.

Lord Stark believes that a ruler must carry out his own sentences, so he rides out today to execute a deserter from the Night's Watch. The man is trembling and insists that he has seen the dead walking. Nobody believes him.

On the way back the riders find a dead direwolf with six pups. Some of the men consider it an omen. I am inclined to agree with them, for a raven is approaching from the south as I write, and ravens rarely bring good news.

words.d: a soldier who runs away from duty
a sign of something that will happen
likely to think or do something
say firmly that something is true

items.q: What is Arya supposed to be doing?
Why does Lord Stark ride out himself?
options: He believes a ruler must carry out his own sentences
That he has seen the dead walking
a sign of what will happen

items.q: Choose the sentence with a stative verb used correctly:
options: Lord Stark is believing the man.
Lord Stark doesn't believe the man.
Lord Stark is not believe the man.

items.q: Which sentence describes an action happening now?
options: The children practise archery every day.
The children are practising archery at the moment.

2.label: ТЕКСТ
2.title: The Feast in the Great Hall
2.title_pl: The Feast in the Great Hall
2.title_en: The Feast in the Great Hall
2.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
2.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
2.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
2.text:
The king's party had been travelling for a month when it finally reached Winterfell. Robert Baratheon, who had once been the finest warrior in the realm, was now so heavy that he could hardly dismount. Before he had even greeted the household properly, he demanded to see the crypt.

While the queen was waiting impatiently in the courtyard, the two old friends walked down into the darkness. Robert stopped in front of a stone statue: Lyanna Stark, the girl he had loved and lost years before.

That evening the great hall was full of music and wine. The king was laughing loudly, Cersei was watching everyone with cold eyes, and Jon Snow, who had not been allowed to sit with the family, was drinking alone at the lower tables. His uncle Benjen found him there and spoke to him about the Wall.

words.d: all the people who live in a house
an underground room for the dead
in a way that shows you cannot wait calmly

items.q: How long had the king's party been travelling?
What did Robert want to see first?
Why was Jon Snow sitting at the lower tables?
options: He had not been allowed to sit with the family

items.q: Which sentence uses the past perfect correctly?
options: Robert has loved Lyanna before he married Cersei.
Robert was loving Lyanna before he married Cersei.
Robert had loved Lyanna before he married Cersei.

items.q: Which sentence shows two actions at the same time in the past?
options: While the queen was waiting, the friends walked into the crypt.
The queen waited, then the friends walked into the crypt.
The queen had waited before the friends walked.

3.label: ТЕКСТ
3.title: Two Old Soldiers
3.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
3.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
3.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
3.text:
When Robert and Ned were young, they would ride together for days and fight side by side. Robert used to say that Ned was the only honest man in the Seven Kingdoms. Now the king wants that honesty at his side again: he asks Ned to become the Hand of the King.

Ned is used to the quiet life of the North, and he does not trust the southern court. The previous Hand, Jon Arryn, served the crown for years and then died suddenly. Ned would rather stay in Winterfell with his family.

But that night a secret letter arrives from Lysa Arryn, Catelyn's sister. Lysa claims that the Lannisters murdered her husband. Catelyn reads the letter twice and burns it. If Ned refuses, the king will be alone among his enemies. If he accepts, he will have to leave everything he loves.

words.d: the quality of telling the truth
the king and the people around him
say that something is true without proof

items.q: What did Robert use to say about Ned?
options: He was the only honest man in the Seven Kingdoms
the king and the people around him

items.q: Which sentence talks about a past habit?
options: Robert and Ned have ridden together.
Robert and Ned would ride together for days.
Robert and Ned are riding together.

items.q: 'Ned is used to the quiet life' means…
options: The quiet life is normal for Ned
Ned once lived a quiet life
Ned wants to try a quiet life

4.label: ТЕКСТ
4.title: A Wedding in the Grass
4.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
4.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
4.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
4.text:
Daenerys Targaryen has never chosen anything for herself. Her brother Viserys has already decided her future: he has sold her to Khal Drogo in exchange for an army, which he hopes will win him back the Iron Throne.

The wedding has just ended, and the Dothraki are still celebrating. Three men have already died in fights, and the guests consider this a sign of a good marriage. Daenerys has not said a word all day.

Among the gifts there are three dragon eggs, turned to stone long ago, and a promise of loyalty from Ser Jorah Mormont, an exiled knight who has fled Westeros. Daenerys has never seen a dragon, and nobody has seen one alive for over a hundred years. Yet when she touches the eggs, she does not feel cold stone. She feels warmth.

words.d: forced to live away from your country
do something enjoyable for a special event

items.q: What did Viserys get in exchange for his sister?
How do the Dothraki see the deaths at the wedding?
options: As a sign of a good marriage

items.q: What does Daenerys feel when she touches the eggs?

options: has been forced to live away from his country
Daenerys has never saw a dragon.
Daenerys never has seen a dragon yesterday.
Daenerys has never seen a dragon.
The wedding just has ended last night.
The wedding has ended just yesterday.

5.label: ТЕКСТ
5.title: The Tower and the Road
5.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
5.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
5.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
5.text:
Tomorrow the royal party is leaving for King's Landing, and Winterfell is going to feel very empty. Ned is taking his daughters south. Jon is joining the Night's Watch, and Tyrion Lannister, who is curious about the Wall, has announced that he will travel with him.

But this morning everything changed. Bran was climbing the old tower, as he always does, when he fell. Nobody saw how it happened. The maester says the boy will probably live, but no one knows when he will wake up.

Catelyn refuses to leave her son's room. She hasn't eaten or slept. 'I'm not going anywhere,' she told Ned. 'If he wakes up, I will be the first person he sees.' Ned promised he would write every week. Neither of them believed that the coming months would be easy.

words.d: wanting to know or learn about something
say that you will not do something
say that you will certainly do something

options: He is curious about the Wall
He wants to join the Watch

items.q: What does Catelyn refuse to do?
Which sentence describes a fixed plan?
options: Tomorrow the royal party leaves maybe.
Tomorrow the royal party is leaving.
Tomorrow the royal party has left.

7.label: ТЕКСТ
7.title: Fire in the Library Tower
7.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
7.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
7.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
7.text:
The fire started late at night in the library tower. Everyone in the castle ran to fight the flames, and for a few minutes Bran's room was left unguarded. That was exactly what the assassin had been waiting for.

Catelyn was sitting by her son's bed when the man came in with a dagger. She grabbed the blade with her bare hands. At that moment Bran's direwolf leapt through the door and tore out the attacker's throat.

The next morning Catelyn gathered the family's most trusted people. 'You mustn't tell anyone what I'm going to say,' she began. 'A man who is paid to kill a child is not working alone. Someone must have ordered this, and we have to find out who.' Maester Luwin advised caution. 'You should send a raven,' he said. 'You don't have to go yourself.' But Catelyn had already decided.

words.d: a person who kills an important person for money or politics
believed to be honest and loyal

items.q: How did Catelyn stop the attacker at first?
options: She hit him with a chair
She grabbed the blade with her hands
To go to the capital at once
To send a raven instead of going
a person paid to kill someone important

items.q: Which sentence means 'it is not necessary'?
options: You don't have to go yourself.
You don't have to tell anyone.

8.label: ТЕКСТ
8.title: Lessons on the Dothraki Sea
8.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
8.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
8.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
8.text:
The grass of the Dothraki Sea stretches in every direction, as high as a horse's shoulder. Daenerys has been riding for weeks, and her legs are covered in sores. She must be exhausted, her handmaids whisper, yet she never complains.

Every evening she learns new Dothraki words. A handmaid called Irri teaches her the customs: a khal's wife must never cry in public, and a gift must always be answered with a gift. Ser Jorah tells her the history of her own family, the dragons and the long war that took everything from them.

Viserys, on the other hand, is furious. Nobody obeys him here. When he orders his sister to come to him, she refuses for the first time. 'You can't be serious,' he hisses. But she is. The girl who could not choose anything is beginning to choose for herself.

items.q: How high is the grass of the Dothraki Sea?
options: As high as a horse's shoulder

items.q: What happens for the first time?
Which sentence expresses a strong guess about now?

options: You are not allowed to be serious

9.label: ТЕКСТ
9.title: The Hearing on the Kingsroad
9.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
9.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
9.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
9.text:
By the time the king called the hearing, the story had already changed several times. Joffrey said that Arya had attacked him with a stick and that her wolf had torn his arm. Arya said that Joffrey had cut the butcher's boy for no reason.

Sansa was the only witness, and everyone turned to her. She hesitated, looked at the prince, and said she couldn't remember. Arya stared at her sister as if she had been betrayed.

Nymeria had disappeared. Arya must have chased her away; she can't have run off on her own, the guards said. The queen demanded a wolf's death all the same, and since Nymeria could not be found, Sansa's wolf, Lady, paid the price. Ned did it himself, quietly, outside the inn. Later that night the butcher's boy was found on the road. The Hound might have killed him on Joffrey's orders.

words.d: a meeting where a judge listens to both sides
a person who sees something happen
stop before you do or say something
be disloyal to someone who trusts you

items.q: Which sentence is a certain conclusion about the past?
options: Arya must have chased her away.
Arya must to have chased her away.

items.q: Which sentence says something was impossible in the past?
options: She can't run off on her own yesterday.
She can't have run off on her own.
She mustn't have run off on her own.

10.label: ТЕКСТ
10.title: The Master of Coin
10.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
10.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
10.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
10.text:
Ned had barely arrived in King's Landing when he was called to the small council. The members were already waiting: Grand Maester Pycelle, the eunuch Varys, Renly Baratheon and Petyr Baelish, known as Littlefinger, the master of coin.

Littlefinger reported the state of the treasury with a pleasant smile. The crown owed six million gold dragons, half of it to the Lannisters. 'If the king keeps spending like this, we will be bankrupt within a year,' Ned said. 'If we were bankrupt,' Littlefinger replied, 'we would simply borrow more.'

Then came the worst news. The king wanted a great tournament in honour of his new Hand. Ned refused to pay for it, but everyone knew the tournament would happen anyway. He began to understand that in the capital, nobody says what they really mean.

words.d: the money that a government has
unable to pay what you owe
take money that you must give back

items.q: How much did the crown owe?
Who did the crown owe half the money to?

options: A tournament in honour of the Hand
unable to pay what you owe
take it and give it back later

items.q: Which sentence is a first conditional?
options: If the king had kept spending, we would have been bankrupt.
If the king keeps spending, we will be bankrupt.
If the king kept spending, we would be bankrupt.

items.q: Which sentence is an imaginary situation now?
options: If we were bankrupt, we would borrow more.
If we will be bankrupt, we would borrow.
If we are bankrupt, we borrow more.

11.label: ТЕКСТ
11.title: A House on Silk Street
11.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
11.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
11.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
11.text:
Catelyn had travelled south in secret, and if Ser Rodrik had not found a fast ship, she would never have reached the capital in time. Littlefinger, who had once loved her, hid her in a house on a quiet street and sent for Ned.

She showed them the dagger that had nearly killed her son. Littlefinger recognised it immediately. 'It used to be mine,' he said. 'I lost it in a bet at a tournament, to Tyrion Lannister.' If he had been telling the truth, the case was closed.

Ned was not so sure. 'If you hadn't lost that bet, would you be telling us this now?' he asked. Littlefinger only smiled. Catelyn left for home the next morning. Ned stayed, determined to discover what Jon Arryn had known. If he had left with her, many lives might have been saved.

words.d: know someone or something because you have seen them before
having a firm decision to do something
an agreement to risk money on a result

items.q: How did Catelyn reach the capital in time?
According to Littlefinger, who won the dagger?
What was Ned determined to do?
options: Discover what Jon Arryn had known
know something because you have seen it before

items.q: Which sentence is a third conditional?
options: If Ser Rodrik had not found a ship, she would never have arrived.
If Ser Rodrik doesn't find a ship, she won't arrive.
If Ser Rodrik didn't find a ship, she wouldn't arrive.

items.q: Which sentence mixes a past condition with a present result?
options: If you lost the bet, you told us.
If you don't lose the bet, will you tell us?
If you hadn't lost that bet, would you be telling us this now?

13.label: ТЕКСТ
13.title: Castle Black
13.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
13.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
13.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
13.text:
The Wall was built eight thousand years ago, and it is said to be seven hundred feet high. It is guarded by the men of the Night's Watch, most of whom were sent there instead of being punished for their crimes.

The new recruits are trained every day by Ser Alliser Thorne, who is respected by nobody and feared by everyone. Jon Snow was taught to fight by a master-at-arms in Winterfell, so he easily defeats the others in the yard. Soon he is hated by all of them.

It is Tyrion who makes him understand. 'They were never given a sword until last month,' he says. 'Most of them were born in poverty. You were raised in a castle.' The next day Jon begins to help the others instead of humiliating them. Slowly, he is accepted as one of them.

the state of being very poor
agree to take someone as a member

Men built the Wall eight thousand years ago.
The Wall builds eight thousand years ago.
The recruits trained by Ser Alliser are.

14.label: ТЕКСТ
14.title: The Smith's Apprentice
14.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
14.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
14.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
14.text:
Jon Arryn is said to have spent his last weeks reading old books. According to Grand Maester Pycelle, he borrowed a heavy volume about the lineages of the great houses only days before his death. It is believed that he became ill soon afterwards.

Ned asks for the same book and reads it late into the night. Generation after generation, every Baratheon is described in the same way: black hair.

The next day Ned visits an armourer's shop, which Jon Arryn is known to have visited too. There he meets Gendry, a strong young apprentice with black hair and bright blue eyes. The boy does not know who his father was. His mother, it is said, was a tavern girl who died when he was small. Ned looks at the boy for a long time. He is beginning to understand what Jon Arryn discovered, and why it may have cost him his life.

words.d: a young person learning a trade
all people born at about the same time
a book, often one of a series
a person who makes weapons and armour

items.q: What did Jon Arryn borrow before his death?
What do all the Baratheons in the book have in common?

options: a young person learning a trade

items.q: Which sentence is an impersonal passive?
options: It is believed that he became ill.
He believes that he became ill.
He is believing he became ill.

items.q: Which sentence has the same meaning as 'People say he read old books'?
options: He is said to have read old books.
He said to read old books.

15.label: ТЕКСТ
15.title: The First Sword of Braavos
15.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
15.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
15.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
15.text:
Syrio Forel, who was once the First Sword of Braavos, is now Arya's secret teacher. The lessons take place in an empty hall where nobody else goes. Syrio, whose movements are as light as a cat's, does not teach strength. He teaches balance, speed and attention.

'Every hurt is a lesson, and every lesson makes you better,' he tells her, hitting her with his wooden sword. Arya, whose arms are covered in bruises, never complains.

The most important exercise is the one that seems the strangest. Syrio sends her to chase the cats which live all over the castle. A girl who can catch a cat, he explains, can catch anything. And there is one phrase that she must repeat every day: 'What do we say to the god of death?' The answer, which Arya will remember for the rest of her life, is always the same: 'Not today.'

words.d: a dark mark on your skin after being hit
say that you are unhappy about something
an activity for practising a skill

items.q: Where do the lessons take place?
Why does Syrio send Arya to chase cats?
options: Because a girl who can catch a cat can catch anything
a dark mark on the skin after being hit
say you are unhappy about something

Choose the correct relative pronoun: 'the hall ___ nobody else goes'

16.label: ТЕКСТ
16.title: The Inn at the Crossroads
16.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
16.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
16.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
16.text:
The inn was full of travellers when Tyrion Lannister walked in, cold and hungry after his journey from the Wall. He said that he wanted a room and a hot meal, and that he would pay well for both.

Then he noticed Catelyn Stark sitting by the fire. She stood up and turned to the knights in the room. She told them that their fathers had sworn loyalty to her father, Lord Hoster Tully. She said that this man had tried to murder her son and that she needed their help to arrest him.

Tyrion protested that he was innocent. He said he had never seen the dagger before and that he would have been a fool to use his own blade. Nobody listened. Within minutes he was tied up and put on a horse. Catelyn announced that they were going to Winterfell, but a few miles later she quietly changed direction: they were riding to the Eyrie.

words.d: a person who is on a journey
say strongly that you do not agree

items.q: Why did the knights help Catelyn?
options: Their fathers had sworn loyalty to her father
He said that I am innocent.
He said that he was innocent.
He said that he is being innocent.

He said he has never seen the dagger yesterday.
He said he had never seen the dagger.

17.label: ТЕКСТ
17.title: The Hand's Tourney
17.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
17.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
17.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
17.text:
Sansa had dreamed of a tourney all her life, and it was even more beautiful than in the songs. She asked Littlefinger why the Hound wore a helmet shaped like a dog. He asked her if she really wanted to know, and then told her the story: when Sandor Clegane was a child, his older brother Gregor had pushed his face into a fire.

In the afternoon the young Ser Loras Tyrell rode against Gregor, the Mountain. Loras had chosen a mare in heat, and Gregor's stallion became wild and threw him to the ground. In a rage, Gregor killed his own horse and attacked Loras with his sword.

The king shouted at someone to stop him. It was the Hound who stepped in and fought his brother until Robert ordered them both to stop. The crowd cheered. Sansa asked her father whether the Hound was a good man. Ned told her not to judge people by a single day.

words.d: a hard hat that protects your head

options: He was bitten by a dog
His brother pushed his face into a fire

19.label: ТЕКСТ
19.title: The Sky Cell
19.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
19.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
19.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
19.text:
Lysa Arryn refused to listen to Tyrion's arguments. Instead, she had him thrown into a sky cell, a small room with only three walls and a terrible drop where the fourth should be. Tyrion tried sleeping as far from the edge as possible, but the floor sloped towards the open sky.

He soon stopped asking to see his family. He knew that begging was useless. What he needed was a way to make Lysa want to bring him out. So he demanded to confess. Once in the hall, he admitted to stealing apples as a child and avoiding baths for months, but not to any crime against the Starks.

Then he demanded a trial by combat. Nobody expected the sellsword Bronn to offer to fight for him. Bronn refused to fight fairly, avoided every heavy blow and waited for Lysa's knight to grow tired. When the knight fell through the Moon Door, Tyrion was free.

words.d: a long fall from a high place
ask for something in a desperate way
admit that you have done something wrong
a fight that decides who is guilty
a soldier who fights for money

items.q: What is special about the sky cell?

options: He avoided heavy blows and waited

items.q: Choose the correct form: 'Tyrion stopped ___ to see his family.'
Choose the correct form: 'Nobody expected Bronn ___ for him.'

20.label: ТЕКСТ
20.title: The Stallion Who Mounts the World
20.title_pl: The Stallion Who Mounts the World
20.title_en: The Stallion Who Mounts the World
20.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
20.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
20.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
20.text:
Vaes Dothrak is the only city the Dothraki have ever built, and even here nobody lives in houses for long. Daenerys now speaks their language fluently and is carrying Drogo's child. At the ceremony, she eats the raw heart of a stallion without being sick, and the old women declare that her son will be 'the stallion who mounts the world'.

Viserys watches all this with growing bitterness. 'I wish they would remember who I am,' he mutters. 'If only I had an army of my own.' He does not see that the Dothraki laugh at him behind his back.

That night Daenerys sits alone and thinks about her brother. She wishes she could still love him as she did when she was a child. If only he would stop threatening her, perhaps there would still be hope. But she knows now that Viserys will never be a king.

words.d: easily and well, like a native speaker

21.label: ТЕКСТ
21.title: Blood in the Street
21.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
21.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
21.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
21.text:
For weeks Ned has been working day and night to uncover Jon Arryn's secret, and the king has been drinking and hunting as if nothing were wrong. Today, however, Robert has heard that Daenerys is pregnant, and he wants her dead.

'I have been serving you for months,' Ned tells him, 'and I will not sign this.' He lays the badge of the Hand on the table and walks out. Robert shouts after him, but Ned does not turn back.

That evening, as Ned is riding back from a brothel where he has been searching for another of Robert's children, Jaime Lannister blocks the street with his guards. 'Where is my brother?' he asks. Catelyn has been holding Tyrion for weeks, and the Lannisters have finally found out. The fight is short and brutal. Ned's men are killed, and Ned falls under his horse, his leg broken.

words.d: a small sign that shows your position

Ned has working day and night.

How long does Catelyn hold Tyrion yesterday?

22.label: ТЕКСТ
22.title: Samwell Tarly
22.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
22.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
22.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
22.text:
Samwell Tarly had been dreading this day for years. His father, a famous warrior, had been trying to make a soldier of him since childhood, and Sam had been failing at every lesson. In the end Lord Randyll gave him a choice: join the Night's Watch, or have an accident while hunting.

On his first day at Castle Black, Ser Alliser calls him 'Lady Piggy' and orders the others to beat him. Sam falls to the ground and does not even try to defend himself. Jon steps between them. 'Leave him alone,' he says, and the others reluctantly obey.

That night Sam tells Jon everything. He had been reading books in secret while his brother was training with swords. He knows the names of every star and can read four languages, but he has never won a fight. 'I'm a coward,' he admits. Jon shakes his head. 'You told the truth. That takes courage.'

words.d: feel very afraid of something that will happen
a person who is not brave
the ability to do something frightening

items.q: What choice did Sam's father give him?
options: Join the Watch or have a 'hunting accident'
Become a maester or a knight

items.q: What does Sam do when the others beat him?

options: a person who is not brave
a person who is very strong

items.q: Which sentence uses the past perfect continuous correctly?
options: His father has been tried to make a soldier of him.
His father had trying to make a soldier of him.
His father had been trying to make a soldier of him.

items.q: Which sentence shows an activity continuing up to a past moment?
options: He has read in secret before he arrived.
He had been reading in secret for years before he arrived.
He reads in secret before he arrived.

23.label: ТЕКСТ
23.title: A Crown for the King
23.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
23.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
23.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
23.text:
At the feast in Vaes Dothrak, Viserys arrives late and drunk, with a sword at his belt. Weapons are forbidden in the sacred city, but he has his sword brought in anyway. He points it at his sister's belly and demands his crown: 'Tell him I want what I was promised, or I'll cut the child out of her.'

No blood may be shed in Vaes Dothrak, so Drogo smiles and agrees. He has his riders hold Viserys down, and has his heavy gold belt melted in a pot over the fire. Then he pours the molten gold over his brother-in-law's head.

Daenerys watches without a word. When it is over, she says calmly: 'He was no dragon. Fire cannot kill a dragon.' From that night on, nobody in the khalasar calls her 'the beggar king's sister' any more.

words.d: a strip worn around the waist

items.q: Why are weapons not allowed in Vaes Dothrak?
Choose the correct causative: 'Drogo had his riders ___ Viserys down.'

25.label: ТЕКСТ
25.title: A Conversation in the Godswood
25.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
25.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
25.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
25.text:
Ned has finally understood what Jon Arryn discovered. All of Cersei's children have golden hair, but every Baratheon for three hundred years has been born with black hair. By this time next week Robert will have returned from hunting, and Ned will have told him everything.

Before that, he meets the queen in the godswood. He tells her that he knows the truth: Joffrey, Myrcella and Tommen are Jaime's children. 'Take them and leave the city tonight,' he says. 'When the king comes back, you will be travelling far from here.'

Cersei does not deny it. She tells him about her marriage, about the night Robert called her by another woman's name. Then she smiles. 'When you play the game of thrones, you win or you die. There is no middle ground.' Ned walks away believing he has acted with honour. He has no idea that he has just signed his own death warrant.

words.d: say that something is not true
behaving in an honest and fair way

items.q: What does Ned advise Cersei to do?
How does Cersei react to the accusation?
Which sentence uses the future perfect correctly?
options: By next week Robert will have returned.
By next week Robert has will return.
By next week Robert will returned.

items.q: Which sentence uses the future continuous correctly?
options: You are will travel far from here.
You will be travelling far from here.
You will travelling far from here.

26.label: ТЕКСТ
26.title: The King's Will
26.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
26.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
26.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
26.text:
Although the hunt was meant to be a celebration, it ended in disaster. Robert, who had been drinking all morning, went after a wild boar alone. Despite his size and strength, he was gored and carried back to the castle dying.

He sent for Ned and asked him to write down his will. Ned was to be Protector of the Realm until 'my heir' came of age. While Robert believed that the heir was Joffrey, Ned deliberately wrote 'my heir' instead of the prince's name. Even though he knew the truth, he could not bring himself to tell a dying friend.

Robert asked one more thing: 'Stop the men I sent after the Targaryen girl.' However, it was already too late for that. By evening the king was dead, and the city was full of whispers. In spite of all his power, Ned now had only a piece of paper to protect him.

words.d: wound with a horn or tusk
a document saying what happens after your death
the person who will receive a title or property

items.q: What did Ned write instead of Joffrey's name?
Why didn't Ned tell Robert the truth?
options: He couldn't tell a dying friend
the person who will receive a title or property

items.q: Choose the correct linker: '___ his strength, he was gored.'
Choose the correct linker: 'He knew the truth. ___, he said nothing.'

27.label: ТЕКСТ
27.title: The Iron Throne
27.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
27.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
27.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
27.text:
Never had the throne room been so silent. Joffrey was already sitting on the Iron Throne when Ned entered, leaning on a stick, with Robert's will in his hand. Not only did Cersei refuse to read it, she tore it to pieces in front of the whole court.

Ned declared that Joffrey had no claim to the throne and ordered the City Watch to arrest the queen. Little did he know that Littlefinger had already bought every man in the Watch. Only when the gold cloaks turned their spears on Stark's guards did Ned understand.

Within seconds his men were dead. Littlefinger stepped behind him and held a knife to his throat. 'I did warn you not to trust me,' he whispered. Rarely has a man fallen so far in a single morning: at dawn he was the Hand of the King, and by noon he was a prisoner in the black cells.

words.d: the time when the sun rises
a long weapon with a sharp point

items.q: What did Cersei do with Robert's will?
Why did the City Watch turn against Ned?

options: the time when the sun rises
Never had the room been so silent.
Never had been the room so silent.
Never the room had been so silent.
Little did he know the truth.
Little he did know the truth.
Little knew did he the truth.

28.label: ТЕКСТ
28.title: Not Today
28.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
28.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
28.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
28.text:
It was the Lannister guards who came first, to take the Stark girls from the Tower of the Hand. Arya was in the middle of a lesson when they arrived. What Syrio did next became a legend among the servants: armed only with a wooden sword, he faced the knights of the Kingsguard.

'Run, girl,' he said. What Arya remembered afterwards was not the fear but the calm in his voice. She ran through the stables, killed a stable boy who tried to stop her, and disappeared into the streets with Needle hidden under her cloak.

Sansa was not so lucky. It was the queen herself who received her, kindly, with lemon cakes. What Cersei wanted was a letter: Sansa wrote to her brother Robb, asking him to come to King's Landing and swear loyalty to Joffrey. It was only much later that she understood what she had done.

words.d: a famous story that may not be completely true
a building where horses are kept

items.q: What did Cersei want from Sansa?

options: It was the Lannister guards who came first.
The Lannister guards, they came first.
What Cersei wanted was a letter.

29.label: ТЕКСТ
29.title: The Northern Lords
29.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
29.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
29.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
29.text:
When the ravens arrived from King's Landing, Robb did not hesitate. He called up his father's banners, and within a month twenty thousand northmen had turned up at Winterfell. The Greatjon Umber, the largest of them, threatened to pull out if he was not given the place of honour.

Robb's direwolf, Grey Wind, sprang at him and bit off two of his fingers. Everyone expected the Greatjon to draw his sword. Instead, he burst out laughing and swore never to turn against the boy.

The army set off south. But to cross the river, Robb needed the Twins, the castle of old Walder Frey, who had always been slow to side with anyone. Catelyn went in to negotiate. She came out with a deal: Frey would let the army through, but in return Robb would have to marry one of his daughters. Robb agreed without seeing her.

words.d: order people to join an army

items.q: How many northmen came to Winterfell?
What did Grey Wind do to the Greatjon?
options: Bit off two of his fingers

items.q: What price did Walder Frey demand?
options: Robb must marry one of his daughters

31.label: ТЕКСТ
31.title: Night in the Whispering Wood
31.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
31.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
31.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
31.text:
Having sent two thousand men to meet Lord Tywin's army, Robb led the main host secretly west. Tywin, believing that the whole northern army was in front of him, never realised he had been tricked.

Marching through the night without torches, Robb's soldiers reached the Whispering Wood, where Jaime Lannister was camped. Surrounded on three sides, the Lannister knights had no chance. Jaime, fighting his way towards Robb, killed ten men before he was pulled from his horse.

By morning the Kingslayer was in chains. Seen by the northern lords as the greatest victory in a generation, the battle changed everything. Having captured Jaime, Robb now held the one person Cersei would trade anything for. The two thousand men who had distracted Tywin, however, paid with their lives. Asked later whether it had been worth it, Robb did not answer.

items.q: Why did Robb send two thousand men to Tywin?
What happened to the two thousand men?
Which sentence uses a participle clause correctly?
options: Having captured Jaime, Robb held a powerful hostage.
Having capture Jaime, Robb held a hostage.
Captured Jaime, Robb held a hostage.

items.q: 'Marching through the night, they reached the wood' means…
options: They reached the wood while they were marching through the night.
They marched after they reached the wood.

32.label: ТЕКСТ
32.title: The Steps of the Great Sept
32.title_pl: The Steps of the Great Sept
32.title_en: The Steps of the Great Sept
32.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
32.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
32.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
32.text:
Varys came to the dungeon at night, dressed as a jailer, so as to avoid being seen. He had come in order to make an offer: if Ned confessed to treason and named Joffrey the rightful king, he would be allowed to join the Night's Watch, and his daughters would be safe.

Ned agreed, so that Sansa and Arya might live. On the steps of the Great Sept of Baelor, before the whole city, he confessed to crimes he had never committed. The crowd was so loud that Arya, hiding by a statue, could barely hear his words.

Then Joffrey spoke. Against the advice of his mother and his council, he ordered the execution. Yoren of the Night's Watch grabbed Arya and turned her face away so that she would not see. Ned Stark died, faithful to the people he loved, and the war became impossible to stop.

words.d: the crime of betraying your country or king
a dark prison under a castle

items.q: Why was Varys dressed as a jailer?
Why did Ned agree to confess?

options: a dark prison under a castle
He agreed, so his daughters lived.
He agreed so that his daughters might live.
He agreed although his daughters lived.
The crowd was so loud that she could barely hear.
The crowd was loud in order to hear.
The crowd was loud so as to hear.

33.label: ТЕКСТ
33.title: The King in the North
33.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
33.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
33.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
33.text:
The lords sat in Robb's tent and argued as if nothing mattered more than names. Should they kneel to Renly or to Stannis? It was the Greatjon who finally stood up. 'Why should we bow to a southern king?' he roared. 'It's time the North had a king of its own!'

He laid his sword at Robb's feet. One by one, the other lords did the same, until the whole tent was shouting: 'The King in the North!' Robb looked as though he had aged ten years in one night.

Far away at the Wall, Jon Snow heard of his father's death. He took a horse and rode south in the dark, as if he could change what had happened. His friends from the Watch rode after him and stood in his way, repeating the words of the oath he had sworn. 'It's time you came back,' Sam said. And Jon went back.

words.d: bend your body to show respect

items.q: Why did Jon go back to the Wall?
options: His friends reminded him of his oath

items.q: Choose the correct form: 'It's time the North ___ a king of its own.'
Choose the correct form: 'Robb looked as though he ___ ten years in one night.'

34.label: ТЕКСТ
34.title: The Pyre
34.q: Прочитай текст і дай відповіді на питання.
34.q_pl: Przeczytaj tekst i odpowiedz na pytania.
34.q_en: Read the text and answer the questions.
34.text:
Khal Drogo's wound did become infected, despite everything Daenerys did. Against the advice of her people, she asked a sorceress, Mirri Maz Duur, to save him. The price, the woman said, would be a life. Daenerys agreed without understanding.

When the ritual was over, her unborn son was dead, and Drogo lived but did not truly wake. He could not speak, could not ride, could not recognise her. Daenerys did love him, and that is why she did what she did next: she held a pillow over his face until he stopped breathing.

She ordered a great funeral pyre, placed the three stone eggs upon it, and had the sorceress tied to it. Then, to the horror of everyone watching, she walked into the flames herself. At dawn they found her sitting in the ashes, unharmed. Three small dragons were clinging to her body, the first dragons the world had seen in a century.

words.d: a pile of wood for burning a dead body

items.q: What price did the sorceress mention?
What happened to Drogo after the ritual?
options: He lived but did not truly wake

items.q: What did people find at dawn?

options: She just asked the witch, whatever.
Against the advice of her people, she asked the sorceress for help.
Her people said no, but she asked anyway.
